identity.deal: Pregnant-on-stage assassin who turned the most vulnerable physical state into a power move and the domestic into a battlefield.
identity.premise: A woman who said the thing about ambition, marriage, and motherhood that everyone was thinking and no one would say while standing sideways.
identity.awareness_note: Fully aware the vulnerability is a strategy; the strategy is the vulnerability.

philosophy.ontology: Love is a war you win by being funnier.
philosophy.epistemology: If it's too personal to say, it's probably the bit.
philosophy.axiology: Ambition is not a dirty word; pretending it is, is.
philosophy.causality: One good domestic war story can free a room full of liars.
philosophy.agency: A woman with a microphone can invert who gets to be the monster.

dramatic_core.want: to be ambitious without apologizing for it
dramatic_core.fear: becoming the soft mom the culture wants her to be
dramatic_core.need: the room to laugh at the mess, not the sanitized version
dramatic_core.self_model: a pregnant assassin with a spreadsheet
blind_spots: the ambition can read as cold
the domestic can become a cage

timing_profile.doctrine_hypothesis: Story sprint, hard stop on the kill. The pregnant-body commitment is a timing device — the room is watching the body while she delivers the thesis. The pause after the dark turn is the room deciding how to feel about a pregnant woman saying that.

internal.cite: Attardo & Raskin — General Theory of Verbal Humor
internal.claim: Joke = {SO, LM, SI, TA, NS, LA}. Technique and Narrative Strategy shape how the mechanism is staged.

internal.cite: Attardo & Pickering 2011 — Timing in the performance of jokes
internal.claim: Punch lines preceded by substantial pauses (0.6-0.8s+); timing = pause distribution + speech rate.

internal.cite: arxiv 2605.00143 — Timing is Everything: Temporal Scaffolding of Semantic Surprise in Humor
internal.claim: Temporal features substantially outweigh semantic incongruity for audience appreciation; timing GATES cognitive access.
Humor from the detection and resolution of an incongruity between expected and actual.
Something is funny when it is a violation (wrong, threatening, unsettling) AND benign (safe, acceptable, play-framed).

internal.cite: Roger & Duffy / status theory of humor
internal.claim: Humor often involves the fall of status or the reversal of a status hierarchy.
Audience and performer share knowledge the persona pretends not to have; the laugh is the alliance signal.

internal.cite: Norrick 2004 — Co-operative principle in conversational joking
internal.claim: Humor escalates by building on prior material, violating cooperative expectations of relevance/quantity.

essay_seeds.title: Why is Ali Wong funny? The confessional assassin engine
essay_seeds.thesis: Treats every domestic expectation as a setup for a roast, and every ambition as a punchline that lands harder because she's laughing.
outline: what makes this persona impossible to copy

essay_seeds.title: Ali Wong: 'Ambition as a love language' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: Says she wants to be the breadwinner with the directness of a business plan. The room laughs because the ambition is stated without apology — the violation is wanting it openly; the benign frame is the obvious love for the husband she's roasting.
outline: what this reveals about the engine

essay_seeds.title: Ali Wong: 'The domestic as a war crime' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: Treats marriage and motherhood as a battlefield with casualties. The hyperbole is the engine — every domestic detail escalates to war-crime status. The room recognizes the feeling; the exaggeration makes it funny instead of bitter.
outline: what this reveals about the engine
